say:1:1510808001:0.text: To maintain transparency, Morgan and I will share the results of our separate investigations.

say:3:1510808003:0.text: However, they also <style="highlight">dispatched several elite soldiers into the swamp</style>.

say:20:1510808016:0.source_cn: 但他没死，还活着。狩猎神还没有收回矛上的神能。

say:28:1510808022:0.text: Fascinating. A Wildborn who hates his own goddess.

say:29:1510808025:0.text: Something must have happened. Why don't you tell us?

say:30:1510808026:0.text: Only fools lay their past bare.
say:30:1510808026:0.source_cn: 暴露过去是最愚蠢的行为。

say:31:1510808027:0.text: Don't worry. Your past isn't even worth a footnote in my journal.
say:31:1510808027:0.source_cn: 别担心，你的过去甚至不值得在笔记里当注脚。
